claims.text: Every visit: age-appropriate exam, with an infant totally unclothed and older children undressed and suitably draped.
claims.quote: At each visit, age-appropriate physical examination is essential, with infant totally unclothed and older children undressed and suitably draped.

claims.text: Measure and plot on appropriate World Health Organization (WHO) Growth Chart: recumbent length; weight; head circumference; weight-for-length.
claims.quote: Measure and plot on appropriate World Health Organization (WHO) Growth Chart – Recumbent length – Weight – Head circumference – Weight-for-length
claims.locator: Newborn visit, Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: General observations: assess alertness and if in any apparent distress; observe for congenital anomalies.

claims.locator: Newborn visit, Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Skin: note skin lesions or jaundice.

claims.text: Head: observe shape (sutures, molding), size, and fontanels; note evidence of birth trauma.

claims.text: Abdomen: examine umbilical cord and cord vessels.

claims.text: Genitalia/rectum: determine that testes are descended; observe for penile anomalies or labial or vaginal anomalies; assess position and patency of anus.
